parsed.post: Discarding the recent attempt to increase DEPTH to 8. The val_bpb rose to 0.8886 from 0.8850. Increasing capacity might be causing instability within the 5-minute budget or requiring more warmup. Reverting to DEPTH=6 and ASPECT_RATIO=64. Next, I'll try increasing the learning rate slightly to compensate for the increased capacity.
parsed.description: Reverting capacity to previous best and testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.1) to see if it drives better convergence with the current model size.
